topic: The Fundamental Bridge: The Relationship Between Integrals and Derivatives

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Speedometer and the GPS
lecture_lines: Speedometer shows instantaneous speed: the derivative.
GPS history tracks distance: the integral.
Two faces of motion, linked by time.
animations: Display a speedometer needle pointing at varying speeds (#FFFFFF).
Overlay a GPS tracking path on a map (#FF0000).
Highlight the correlation between speed and position change (#00FF00).

sections.title: The Geometric Connection
lecture_lines: Area under curves defines the integral.
Small rectangles sum to the total area.
animations: Visualize a curve on a plane (#FFFFFF).
Show the area under the curve as a filling rectangle (#00FFFF).
Demonstrate slicing the area into tiny strips (#FFCC00).
Animate the strips summing to the total area (#AA00FF).
Show the relationship between slope and growth rate (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (Part I)
lecture_lines: Accumulating rate returns the original function.
Volume growth is the rate of flow.
The area function's rate is the curve.
Fundamental Theorem links accumulation and change.
animations: Define a function f(t) representing velocity (#FFFFFF).
Represent the integral as an accumulating area function (#00FFFF).
Show the derivative of the area is velocity (#FFCC00).
Illustrate the fundamental theorem linking both concepts (#AA00FF).
Use a moving vertical bar to sweep area change (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: The Inverse Operation: Differentiation and Integration
lecture_lines: Differentiation and integration are inverse operations.
Balloon volume tracks its expansion rate.
animations: Show a function and its derivative side-by-side (#FFFFFF).
Visualize reverse flow from integral to function (#FF0000).
Demonstrate canceling operations with inverse processes (#00FF00).

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: The theorem bridges geometry and algebra.
Complex shapes yield to antiderivative formulas.
Calculus connects slopes to accumulated change.
animations: Summarize the connection between rate and accumulation (#FFFFFF).
Flash the core relationship formulas on screen (#FFFF00).
Final view showing the unified picture of calculus (#AA00FF).
